`--ak proxy=true` works again: the in-box LiteLLM proxy is served from a venv of its own instead of the box's monorepo workspace venv. Against a recent mngr SHA it failed bring-up with `the in-box LLM proxy did not come up`, recording the trial as a timeout with an `ImportError: Missing dependency No module named 'backoff'` traceback in `proxy.log`.

The box image builds `/opt/eval_proxy` from `apps/modal_litellm/image_requirements.txt` -- the hash-locked export the deployed proxy's own image installs -- and the driver starts the proxy from that venv. Keeping it separate is what makes it stable: the workspace venv carries plain `litellm`, whose CLI refuses to serve without the `[proxy]` extra (that extra's `gunicorn<24` cap stays confined to modal-litellm's image group), and every `uv run` in the box re-syncs that venv from the lock, so proxy dependencies added there would be stripped out from under a running proxy mid-trial.
